title: Vermont Healthcare Interoperability: Assessing the VHIE Data Liquidity Fabric
summary: This technical brief evaluates the transition of the Vermont Health Information Exchange (VHIE) toward a real-time data liquidity model. It examines the reduction of policy friction and the implementation of automated clinical data reconciliation across the Agency of Human Services.

children.text: The evolution of the Vermont Health Information Exchange (VHIE) represents a shift from static document exchange to an active interoperability fabric. By addressing technical deflation in legacy systems, the Agency of Digital Services is enabling a seamless clinical identity for every Vermonter.

body.title: Briefing: Overcoming Policy Friction
body.summary: A technical analysis of the legislative hurdles required to enable universal data liquidity within the state's rural provider network.

children.text: The true cost of healthcare is not in the delivery of care, but in the friction of the data that precedes it. Data liquidity is the only viable path to economic sustainability.
